content:
**Ammosmith** is an Agility-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Extra rounds of ammo while crafting.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★ | 2 | Produce 80% more rounds when crafting ammunition. | 003BB50D | 
| ★ | 1 | Produce 40% more rounds when crafting ammunition. | 003896DB | 

Despite increasing the ammunition product per craft, the perk has no effect on unrefined gunpowder.
